description: Alerts the agent script when a chat/messaging interaction has had no agent reply for State.ThresholdMinutes. Started per interaction by a trigger on v2.detail.events.conversation.{id}.user.start.
name: Chat Idle Monitor

variables.name: State.ThresholdMinutes
variables.description: Minutes of agent silence before the first alert

variables.name: State.RepeatEveryMinutes
variables.description: Re-alert interval while still idle; 0 = alert once

variables.name: State.OnlyWhenCustomerWaiting
variables.description: Alert only when the customer's last message is newer than the agent's

variables.description: Output of GC - Get Message Conversation Activity
